nodes.Name: Config
nodes.DocComment:
Config holds GitHub integration settings.
Loaded from env vars; overrideable at runtime via /api/github/config.

nodes.Name: LoadConfig
nodes.DocComment:
LoadConfig reads GitHub config from environment variables.
Returns an error if required fields (token, owner, repo) are missing.

nodes.Name: Client
nodes.DocComment: Client is a thin GitHub REST API wrapper.

nodes.Name: NewClient
nodes.DocComment: NewClient returns a Client ready to make authenticated GitHub API requests.

nodes.Name: do
nodes.DocComment:
do executes a GitHub API request and decodes the JSON response into dst.
dst may be nil if the caller doesn't need the response body.

nodes.Name: GetRef
nodes.DocComment: GetRef returns the current SHA of a git ref (e.g. "refs/heads/main").

nodes.Name: CreateRef
nodes.DocComment: CreateRef creates a new git branch at the given SHA.

nodes.Name: UpsertFile
PRRequest
nodes.DocComment: PRRequest is the payload for creating a pull request.

nodes.Name: PRResponse
nodes.DocComment: PRResponse is the GitHub API response for a created pull request.

nodes.Name: CreatePR
nodes.DocComment: CreatePR opens a pull request and returns the PR number and URL.

nodes.Name: SafeConfig
nodes.DocComment:
Config returns a copy of the client's current configuration
with the token redacted for safe logging.
